description: Photorealistic fabric photo assets. Full-canvas garment silhouette masks are taken from the unchanged layered WadaLens SVG images at render time. Each SVG embeds its original photo so no reference to an external experiment branch remains.
notes: The browser composites each garment as a separate transparent layer.
Six base photographic cutouts are derived from the previous experiment and embedded in independent self-contained SVG assets.
Tie and scarf are generated satin/silk texture studies.
The supplied high-resolution example pictures inspired this experiment but are not the original files committed to GitHub.
Human body, skin and face remain illustrated in this first garment-layer test.
alignment: Photo sources are clipped to WadaLens's existing registered SVG garment silhouettes, so the output alpha exactly matches the original garment shapes.
recolor: Selected Wada colors are applied as a color blend preserving photo texture, highlights and shadows.
